steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Select the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the CYLINDER product and select the matching product option.
Set the first product quantity to 10.
Confirm the requested quantity was retained.
Choose the required delivery location from the sheet dropdown.
Confirm the delivery location was retained.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add one QA vendor so the event can be published and the resulting template can include a vendor column.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Attempt to activate the bid-template download control on the published event.
Confirm that a file was downloaded.
